getDeferBlocks.summary: Finds the @defer blocks a component renders in its shadow root, to drive them in a test.
getDeferBlocks.description:
getDeferBlocks(host) returns the @defer blocks the component of host renders in its shadow root, in the order they are rendered: the ones rendered by the content of another block are found once that content is rendered, and the ones destroyed, as by an @if becoming false, are left out. Each one is a DeferBlockFixture, telling the part it shows and showing another one at once.

Only the blocks rendered once @xaendar/core/testing is imported are found: import it in the spec, before rendering the component. The blocks of the components the component renders are found from their own elements.

drivingByHand.title: Driving a block by hand
drivingByHand.body: With setDeferBlockBehavior('manual') the triggers never fire: the test shows each part with render, the content once its modules are loaded.

setDeferBlockBehavior.summary: Sets how the @defer blocks rendered from now on behave in the tests.
setDeferBlockBehavior.description:
'playthrough', the default once @xaendar/core/testing is imported, lets the blocks behave as in the browser: their triggers fire, and their times pass. 'manual' arms neither their triggers nor their when, nor the triggers following prefetch: each block shows its @placeholder until the test shows another part with the render of the blocks getDeferBlocks finds.

It applies to the blocks rendered after the call: call it before rendering the component, and set 'playthrough' again after the test, so that the next ones play through.

DeferBlockFixture.summary: A @defer block a component renders, as a test drives it.
DeferBlockFixture.description: It is what getDeferBlocks returns for each block: the part the block shows, and the function showing another one at once, whatever its triggers and its times.

members.state: The part the block shows: 'placeholder' before a trigger fires, 'loading' while the modules of the content load, 'complete' once the content is rendered, 'error' when the modules fail to load.
members.render: Shows a part of the block at once, stopping its triggers and its times: 'complete' once the modules of the content are loaded, 'error' with the error given, which the @error receives under its name. The promise is rejected when the block does not declare the part, or the modules fail to load.

DeferBlockState.description: 'placeholder': its @placeholder, before a trigger fires, or nothing without one. 'loading': its @loading, while the modules of the content load. 'complete': the content. 'error': its @error, when the modules fail to load.

DeferBlockBehavior.summary: How the @defer blocks behave in the tests.
DeferBlockBehavior.description: 'playthrough': as in the browser, their triggers firing and their times passing. 'manual': their triggers never fire, and the test shows each part with render. See setDeferBlockBehavior.
